concerns.text: Task T013e (Construct/Validate Environmental Matrix with ontology mapping) is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`). This leaves FR-001 (automated ontology mapping for biome labels) and the metadata preparation required for FR-008 (MICE) unimplemented. The spec requires this step to proceed to analysis.

Task T014 (Memory Safety & Streaming Logic) is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`). This leaves FR-009 (runtime/memory limits with mandatory random subsampling if >6GB) without an implementing task. The plan explicitly requires this to prevent 7GB RAM constraint violations on the GitHub runner.

Task T046 (Explicit sample size justification/power analysis) is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`). This leaves SC-002 (valid p-values) and the Edge Case requirement for power analysis unsupported. The plan lists `results/power_analysis_report.md` as a mandatory output artifact.

Task T047 (Homogeneity of dispersion check) is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`). This leaves the 'Complexity Tracking' requirement in plan.md (to ensure PERMANOVA reflects location, not dispersion) and SC-002 (valid p-values) unverified. The spec Edge Cases imply this check is necessary for valid PERMANOVA interpretation.

Task T048 (Collinearity matrix visualization) is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`). While T016 handles VIF calculation, the plan's 'Output Artifacts' section and the need to verify SC-006 (collinearity risk) require the `results/plots/correlation_matrix.png` which this task is the only one to generate.

Task T049 (Detailed provenance logging) is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`). This leaves Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and Principle III (Data Hygiene) partially unmet, as the plan requires logging 'exact command line arguments, software versions, and input file checksums' for every step to `results/provenance_log.json`.

Task T013a1 is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`) but describes logic that contradicts the spec's Edge Cases. The spec requires an immediate FATAL abort in Research Mode if <3 datasets are found. T013a1 describes logging a warning and proceeding in Validation Mode, but the task status being incomplete creates ambiguity about whether the FATAL abort logic (T040) is correctly linked to the dataset count verification.
